outline:
本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解有機材料之最新開發成品或最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic materials. Speakers being invited are well-known scholars in organic area.  Graduate students or thesis advisors will also be invited to report any in interesting result from their graduate studies.

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
flexible_learning.content:
學術專題深化：運用 AI 工具進行前沿文獻綜述、研究批判性分析與論點優化。
Research Synthesis: Use AI tools for advanced literature review, critical analysis, and thesis refinement.

成果展演評量：進行專題口頭報告與學術海報展，促進學術思辯與同儕同審。
Showcase & Assessment: Deliver oral and poster presentations to foster academic debate and peer review.
flexible_learning.outcome:
專案報告與發表 (7分)：評估研究論點深度、批判分析品質與學術口頭簡報表現。
Project Report & Presentation (7 pts): Assess depth of research argument, critical analysis, and oral delivery.

AI歷程與同儕協作 (3分)：評核 AI 工具輔助文獻驗證紀錄、研討會提問互動及同儕互評。
AI Integration & Peer Collaboration (3 pts): Evaluate AI verification logs, seminar engagement, and peer review.

assessment:
專題演講心得報告: 50%
文獻報告: 30%
課程參與: 10%
